title: Auto Calculate Makes Us Dumb!
body:
An annoying new auto calculate AI-powered functionality has been added to the app in the last few days. Just like predictive text, it predicts the answer to mathematical questions. So if you type ‘1+1=‘ in your notes (and indeed even in this review box I’m typing now, I just discovered!) then it gives you the answer ‘2’ by default. 

Not only is it not possible to permanently turn off this function (you can only turn it off for each individual note, but not the whole Notes app), but it’s forced on you, dumbing you down, in cases where you want to use the app for educational purposes, for example. 

My son has this Notes app on his iPad and uses it as part of working out answers to his maths homework. What’s the point of using the notes, or indeed his iPad to do his homework, now that the AI will do the homework for him???!!! And the fact that I can’t turn it off permanently, is simply intrusive, counter-productive and annoying. 

Lastly, there are times where I need to type an = sign or an equation to explain something to someone (like I did above). The auto calculate function will by default type the answer and won’t let me delete the answer no matter how hard I tried!!! The only workaround is to put quotation marks or something similar around it to indicate to the AI that this isn’t a maths problem to which it must give me an answer by brute force. 

What a stupid functionality that makes people stupid. Whose bright idea was this, and why am I not given the choice to turn it off? How’s my child to continue using Apple for his homework now that the AI gives him all the answers without he or I asking the AI to do so???

title: Deeply frustrated
body:
I have been using the notes app as a complete replacement of a pen and paper notebook for almost three years. I do all my everyday note taking for work, including minutes of important meetings, in the notes app. I has been almost perfect and I chose it over other third party apps because I loved the handwriting experience from the beginning, the simplicity and the native capability to sync with my iPhone and Macbook.

However, in the last six months I have come across two problems. The first seems like a small bug, which I expected would have been fixed by now, this being that when you insert space between handwritten text you can no longer do so with precision because the text ‘jumps’ the moment you release it. This should be a small fix and it is frustrating that it has been present for so long. The second issue is much worse. It has now happened several times that after I have finished taking notes and left the application, when I return a big chunk of my notes have disappeared and I have e no way of retrieving this crucial information. Each time it happened it didn’t happen again for a while, just long enough for me to believe the issue is resolved but just when I least expect it, it happens again. This is a costly flaw and I am seriously having to consider an alternative note taking app.

My issue with it is that I experience severe lag after only a couple paragraphs of writing using the Apple Pencil. Both OneNote and GoodNotes handle handwriting perfectly fine for unlimited lines. Surely this should be an easy fix? Why hasn’t it been solved yet? I’d have thought that the ability to write without lag would be a given for an app so well designed for Apple Pencil, which makes it all the more disappointing that this issue exists. 

It’s not completely unusable, but I do hope that this is resolved in the next update. Just that one change would change this review to 5 stars.

title: Room for improvement
body:
I’ve been using Notes for a while and like how quickly it opens, and generally how easy it is to use. However I think there are a few simple things which which would improve it.

At the moment the folder icons are all yellow, it would be better if we could choose different colours for specific folders (to highlight important ones), and to change the default colour.
Smart Folders are not as useful as they could be - recently I wanted a Smart Folder to collect all notes with the #Character #Illustration and #Prop tags. But it was empty. It turns out each note must have ALL of the above tags or they’ll be ignored. Which doesn’t make much sense. I could make a new tag and retroactively add it to existing notes, but that creates a lot of extra work for the user.
Tables are nice to have, but would be even better if they could do simple addition of all the numbers in a column.
To do lists are useful, but the option to have them show up in the reminders app could be very handy.
Change the background colour of a note. It would be a bit easier on the eyes for some of us.
